main_text.p: In Gorgia Pindari teftimonio probat,quòd lex,hoc eft, honefti & æqui regula immortalibus & mortalibus omnibus præsit:ἀγεῖ βίαιας τὸ δικαιότατον ὑπέρτατα χειρί[?]: hoc eft, quod iuftum eft,eius debet effe fuprema auctoritas.

Et in 1.lib.[?] πολιτειῶν de confcientia agens mala, vt affecta fit, pulchrè docet. Bonæ verò confcientiæ, quæ nullius mali fibi confcia eft, ἡδεῖα ἐλπὶς ἀεὶ παρέσῃ[?], ἢ ἀγαθὴ γνώμη τρόφος[?], vt ait Pindarus:optimum docet, bona confcientia effe præditum,autoritate Pindari.
2 Polit. citat elegans dictum Pindari in cunctatores Expectém-ne ferum iuftitiæ auxilium, aut iuuem me ipfe malitia?

Lib. 3.νόμων Pindari teftimonio, meliores oportere dominari,deteriores vero parere, vbi σοφότατον Pindarum diuinus Plato vocat.Quintum axioma eft ibi, quòd potentiores dominari, imbelliores parere debeant. Imperium vocat fecundùm naturam, & quod in animantibus reperiatur plurimis fecundùm Thebanum Pindarum: cuius & aliis nonnullis in locis honorificam mentionem facit.

Transfeamus ad alium. Athenæus in dipnofoph. lib.1. cap.23. quæstionem Phyficam explicans, cur vinum vetuftum laudetur, Pindari teftimonio vtitur ex Olymp.θ. stroph. 2.ἀγνεῖ δὲ πάλαιὸν μέλυ οἶνον, ἄνθεα δὲ ὑμνων νεωτέρων, πίν-δαρος ἐπαινεῖ[?], hoc eft,nouum vinum & Pindarus laudat, & hymnorum iuniorum florem,hoc eft, virum iuuenem, & vetus vinum commendat.

Et cap.25. eiufdem ,infignia quædam regionum propria commemorans, ex Pythiis citat, ex Taugeto Laccenam canem effe præftantiffimam ad venationem: Syriæ capras effe lacte abundantiffimas:arma Argiua commendari: Thebanus currus: Siciliam vehiculis ingeniosam effe.

Lib.2. cap.2.de aquarum natura difputans, fontis Tilphoffæ in Sicilia aquam præftantiffimam probat folius Pindari teftimonio μεγίστης[?] ἀμβροσίου ὕδωρ Τιλφώσας ὑπὸ χαλλικρῶν[?]. Eft autè Siciliæ fons Tilphoffa,ex quo bibiffe

page.notes: Printed text is sharp except where marked. Greek readings are uncertain and marked [?]: the Pindar quotations in the Greek of the first paragraph, the Athenaeus quotation, and the last Greek phrase. "1.lib." may be "r.lib."; the "2" before "Polit." and the "3" after "Lib." are read as printed numbers in the text. "cap.23." and "cap.25." are read as printed; the number after "cap." may be unclear. Catchword "Tire-" is at the foot right; the last full line ends "bibiffe". No marginal notes are printed on this page.
